tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// chu gtor bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyu dang tshegs chung zhing phan yon dang 'bras bu che ba'i chu gtor gtang ba'i rim pa ni/ 'khar ba dang bse ma yin pa'i snod gtsang mar chu gtsang ma dang*/ phye gtsang ma dang me tog sna tshogs dang*/ sman lnga dang*/ 'bru lnga dang*/ rin po che lnga dang*/ dri lnga dang*/ dar sna tshogs pa btab la/ rang nyid bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro bya/ de nas sesam can thams cad la dmigs pa'i tshad med bzhi bsgom/ phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgom/ rang bzhin med pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ zhes pa'i sgra grags pas rang gi sems pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du muṃ ser po zhig tu bsam/ de'i mtha' mar oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ zhes pa'i yi ges g.yas phyogs su bskor bar bsgom/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri yu bar mum̐ gyis mtshan pa cig tu bsgom/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas gcig tu gyur pa las rang 'phags pa 'jam dpal du gyur par bsam/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas pu sti thugs kar 'dzin par bsam/ de'i spyi bor hūm̐ sngon po cig bsam/ de nas zhu nas thim pas lus thams cad rdo rje'i go gyon par bsam/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'ang ci rigs par bya'o// de dag ni bsam rgyud kyi rim pa'o// de nas yo byad brtag cing byin gyis brlab pa ni chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dha s+sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes pas nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dag par bsam mo// nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ na moḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i ma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/

zhes brjod pas gtor ma'i yo byad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i yo byad nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur par bsam/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod pas/ mgron so so'i lus kyi nad dang sems kyi zug rngu zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam mo// rgyal chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya byas la/ na ma s+sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ zhes brjod pas yo byad rnams 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar gzhal yas khang bkod pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyis phyi nang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis gang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga char gyi rgyun bzhin du babs par bsam/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ki te na maḥ sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dza la ni hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas rang gi lus zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam par gyur nas 'phags pa rnams la phul bas 'phags pa rnams mnyes par bsam/ gtor ma'i yo byad la mgron thams cad 'thab pa dang*/ rtsod pa med par mthun pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ gra she shwa ri pra bhañdza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas sri zhu'i mgron dang*/ yon tan gyi mgron dang*/ snying rje'i mgron dang*/ lan chags kyi mgron du gyur pa thams cad la'ang dam tshig gi dbang gis bdag la 'go zhing stong grogs su 'gyur bar mngon sum du bsam/ gzhan yang sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba'i las thams cad sgrub par bsam/ phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan zhing sngags rnams lan gsum mam bdun du brjod do// de nas mgron rnams spyan drang ba ni/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bsams la/ na mo bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab// sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de// 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu// 'di na snod min sems can gang yang med// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha// dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis na// sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum// yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru// gtan pa med pa'i mchog sbyin spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas te ma lus gshegs su gsol// rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal nyan thos dang*// lha srin sde brgyad 'gro drug sems can dang*// bgegs rnams gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la// spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su byon nas sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de la pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis so so la pad+ma'i gdan dbul/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha la sogs pas mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang rol mo dbul/ de nas bsngo ba dngos ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyi brlabs dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i mthu dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu mi bslu ba'i byin gyi rlabs kyis sri zhu'i mgron du gyur pa sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos la sogs pa thams cad la dbul lo// de rnams kyi pho brang dang gzhal yas khang du kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byam rgya mtsho phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig yon tan gyi mgron du gyur pa/

mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ gza' chen po brgyad dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang ba bzang po dang*/ nor bu bzang po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po yang dag shes dang*/ rgyal ba khyu mchog la sogs te phyogs mtshams srung bar byed pa'i gnod sbyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ dpal ha ri ka dang*/ pañtsi ka la sogs te gtsug lag khang gi srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po btsun mo sras dang 'bangs su bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// de rnams kyi pho brang du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga bar snang la char bzhin bab/ sa gzhi la lo tog bzhin skyes/ nam mkha' la sprin bzhin gtibs nas dgyes rab kyi mchog mnyes rab kyi phul thob par gyur cig de rnams kyi spyan sngar phrin las dang snyan snyun du gsol ba ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bstan pa la bar chad byed pa thams cad zlog pa dang*/ zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo// khyad par du yang bdag cag rnal 'byor pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bde legs 'phel ba'i phrin las chen po mdzad du gsol/ snying rje'i mgron du gyur pa 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ dmyal ba'i gnas yan chad 'phags pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no// gsol lo// bsngo'o// mgron no// de dag so so'i spyan lam dang mnga' ris su so so ci la dgyes pa dang*/

gang dang gang gis 'dul ba/ chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod ci 'dod pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig yul phyogs kyi lha mgon dang klu mgon du gyur pa/ sa bdag klu gnyan la'ang sbyin zhing stsal bas so so'i rnam par rig pa la ci 'dod pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig lan chags kyi mgron du gyur pa bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sa dang bar snang la gnas nas 'dod pa'i gegs byed mi 'dod pa skyed par byed pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag gi tshe rabs kyi lan chags su gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen bgegs su gyur pa thams cad la'ang sbyin zhing stsal bas gnod pa'i bsam pa bsal nas phan pa dang*/ bde ba bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur cig gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po 'di// chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*// dkon mchog yon tan dpag med che ba dang*// snying po phyag rgya nges pa'i dam tshig dang*// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa'i nus mthu dang*// drang srong rig 'dzin rnams kyi grub pa dang*// bdag gi smon lam shes rab ting 'dzin gyis// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// dbang po lnga yi longs spyod mkho dgur ldan// nam mkha'i mthas klas gter chen gyur pa 'di// mchod gnas bla ma khyod kyi pho brang du// mchod pa'i sprin gyis rgyas shing gtibs par smon// bdag gi bsod nams mthu yis ni// sems can thams cad bder gyur cig /kun kyang gnod pa rnams dang bral// yang na de bzhin gshegs gsungs pa'i// 'dod pa phun sum tshogs gyur cig /sgrib pa med pa'i tshul gyis su// ma thogs par ni grub par shog /byol song gcig la gcig za ba// gnod pa de dag yong mi 'byung*// yi dwags rnams la zas dang skom// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur shog /sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gang*// mi bzad rnam pa sna tshogs pa// bsod nams 'di yi byin rlabs kyis// de dag myur du zhi gyur cig

/sa'am mkha' la 'khod pa yi// lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang*// 'byung po mang po gang 'khod pa// dge ba'i bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs// sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// thams cad du ni sdom pa legs// thams cad srung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ de ltar zang zing gi sbyin pas dbang po'i rgyud tshim/ chos kyi sbyin pas shes pa'i rgyud grol nas/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs lhun gyis grub nas mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yang rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod par bya ste/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ni// dge sbyong dge slong de yin bram ze'ang de// 'chi bas mi 'jigs gang yang med// 'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem// rang gi lus la dpe long la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig

/ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams la/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod la gshegs su gsol/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams la// mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang gzhan sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad thams cad 'gro bar gyis// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ zhes brjod pas rang gi gnas su gtang*/ drag po'i sngags brjod/ rol mo brdung*/ rang gi lus bsrung*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma rnams mi 'gom pa'i sar dor ro// chu gtor ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i zhal gdams yi ger 'phags pas bkod pa rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
